42.p90_definition: Hyndman–Fan type 7 (linear; at n=10, x[8] + 0.1 × (x[9]−x[8]) in zero-based ascending order)

42.definition: Per-fold stripe index is 1 + ring excess + cap excess. Each box takes the maximum across five folds. The ring-only and cap-only floors independently set the other side's ratio to one and then recompute the maximum.
